convention: H = -sum_{i<j} J_ij S_i.S_j; each pair once; |S| = spin quantum number (Fe3+ 5/2, Fe2+ 2, Mn2+ 5/2, Co2+ 3/2); J>0 ferromagnetic; J in meV; energies per simulation cell
model_notes: proportional columns merged: the fit determines J[shell0_2.90A] + 3*J[shell2_3.36A]

runtime.basis: seconds/iteration 5.0 s x 14 iterations (config systems.hematite; FEASIBILITY pilots); slowdown factor is an assumption

U_eff_Fe_eV.method: VASP, PAW, PBE GGA+U (Dudarev, U_eff = 3 eV on Fe 3d, from linear response), 92-atom hexagonal cell P63/mmc (SrW), gamma-centred 5x5x1 k-mesh (SCF), cutoff 600 eV, SCF 1e-6 eV, forces <0.01 eV/A; SOC noncollinear for MAE with 12x12x2 k-mesh and Bloechl tetrahedra; collinear Gorter ferrimagnet 4e,4f1,4f3 antiparallel to 6g,4f2,12k,2d; K/Ca/Ba/La replace half of the Sr atoms at 2b (symmetry P-6m2)

literature_deviations: Gamma-only k mesh instead of Gamma-centred 5x5x1 (laptop budget, FEASIBILITY section 4); needs a 2x2x1 check on 2-3 configurations
Quantum ESPRESSO ultrasoft/PAW pseudopotentials instead of VASP PAW; ortho-atomic Hubbard projectors instead of the VASP sphere projection
U on Co and Mn is NOT from L05 (Fe only)
